item.title: Cardamom and Apple by Swiss Arabian – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Swiss Arabian
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Cardamom and Apple by Swiss Arabian is a bold, warm spicy-fruity Eau de Parfum for men.

Green mandarin, green apple and cardamom open fresh, orange blossom, lavender and nutmeg warm the heart, and tonka, amber and leather leave a sensual, confident trail, often compared to Giorgio Armani Code Profumo.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Green Mandarin, Green Apple, Cardamom
Middle: Orange Blossom, Lavender, Nutmeg
Base: Tonka Bean, Amber, Leather

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection
